newsitem.title: FRANCE: TENNIS-TOP SEEDS RIOS AND ENQVIST THROUGH FIRST ROUND.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-TOP SEEDS RIOS AND ENQVIST THROUGH FIRST ROUND.

text.p: Top two seeds Marcelo Rios and Thomas Enqvist reached the second round of the Marseille Open tennis tournament with straight-sets wins on Wednesday.
Chilean top seed Rios was made to work in the first set by Spaniard Juan Albert Viloca before winning his first-round match 7-6 6-4.
Enqvist, the second seed, was more impressive as he crushed fellow Swede Patrik Fredriksson 6-1 6-2.
Rios meets Belgian Johan van Herck in the second round on Thursday while Enqvist faces an interesting test against Slovak Dominik Hrbaty.
